See the Academic Advising Programs website for information on California Promise and Associate Degree for Transfer. See the University Catalog for Credit by Exam information (AP, IB, CLEP). This degree completion program is designed for students who have at least 60 units of lower division credit completed and are looking to finish their college requirements and bachelor's degree. The 60-unit program is offered entirely online and can be completed in four semesters (for students who have completed lower division GE and American Ideals/Institutions). Students entering with more than 60 units of applicable transferrable credit may complete sooner.

This degree completion program is designed for students who have at least 60 units of lower division credit completed and are looking to finish their college requirements and bachelor's degree. The 60-unit program is offered entirely online and can be completed in four semesters (for students who have completed lower division GE and American Ideals/Institutions). Students entering with more than 60 units of applicable transferrable credit may complete sooner.

notes.content: The BA in Multicultural and Gender Studies Online Degree Completion is an approved match to the AA-T in Social Justice Studies.
notes.contentHtml: The BA in Multicultural and Gender Studies Online Degree Completion is an approved match to the AA-T in Social Justice Studies.

notes.content: Students are strongly encouraged to complete one of the following Areas of Specialization. Not all Areas of Specialization include lower division coursework. See the University Catalog for a full listing of degree requirements. American Indian Studies Specialization (listed below) African American Studies Specialization Intersectional Chicanx/Latinx Studies Specialization (listed below) Women's Studies Specialization Queer and Trans Studies Specialization Students wishing to pursue other elective options should work with an Multicultural and Gender Studies advisor. Students are encouraged to select the course in Group 1B that best supports their chosen Area of Specialization.
notes.contentHtml:
Students are strongly encouraged to complete one of the following Areas of Specialization. Not all Areas of Specialization include lower division coursework. See the University Catalog for a full listing of degree requirements.

  • American Indian Studies Specialization (listed below)
  • African American Studies Specialization
  • Intersectional Chicanx/Latinx Studies Specialization (listed below)
  • Women's Studies Specialization
  • Queer and Trans Studies Specialization

Students wishing to pursue other elective options should work with an Multicultural and Gender Studies advisor.


Students are encouraged to select the course in Group 1B that best supports their chosen Area of Specialization.
